name: Machete
note: The Support's execution blade (ClassKnives.csv). Scaled 4/3 like the pack's bayonet (to the real M9's size): 38 cm. The blade runs to -Z; its straight sawback spine is +X and its curved belly (edge, 6.4 cm deep at the tip) -X, so tip [0,0,-1] and up [1,0,0]. The origin is the middle of the handle. Markers: Tip, Edge (mid-blade), Pommel.
